preregistration.unit: participant (per-person mean bias on 20+ pairs), Mann-Whitney, bootstrap CI of the difference in medians, men minus women; pooled-pair checks use a participant bootstrap
preregistration.fallback_rule: a split is testable per person when 10+ people of each sex have 20+ pairs in it; otherwise the registered p comes from a mixed model (random intercept per person) on the pooled pairs of that split, and the estimate shown is the pooled men-minus-women gap with a participant-bootstrap CI. Both versions are reported for every split.

families.replace_bg: blocks A (splits), B (low profile and matching), C (body and physiology), F (decision thresholds); one BH family
